before:
Tidal Mill Trust — Notice to Weekend Volunteers

When fewer than three volunteers sign on for a Saturday shift, the duty keeper works down the standing list of tasks in the following order: the sluice gate inspection is attended before the grain-floor sweeping, and the grain-floor sweeping before cover of the visitor desk. Every one of these tasks remains open to any volunteer who has completed the half-day induction, and none is dropped from the day's work; the list simply settles which is picked up first when hands are short. Keepers should note the finishing time of each task on the shift card so that the trustees can judge whether the Saturday allocation is still sensible over the winter opening.
after:

before:
Fen Drainage Board — Pump House Attendants' Handbook, Section 4

The intake chamber at Halvergate station is reached by the stepped hatch on the eastern side. During routine screen clearance the chamber may be entered by a single attendant, provided the harness line is clipped to the rail at the head of the steps. The attendant records entry and exit times in the station book kept in the switch cabinet. Where the level gauge reads above the painted band, entry is not undertaken at all until the board's engineer has attended. Torches and the spare harness live in the same cabinet and are checked each quarter against the inventory card, which the district supervisor initials on the reverse.
after:
Fen Drainage Board — Pump House Attendants' Handbook, Section 4

The intake chamber at Halvergate station is reached by the stepped hatch on the eastern side. During routine screen clearance the chamber must not be entered unless two attendants are present, one of whom remains at the head of the steps throughout. The attendant records entry and exit times in the station book kept in the switch cabinet. Where the level gauge reads above the painted band, entry is not undertaken at all until the board's engineer has attended. Torches and the spare harness live in the same cabinet and are checked each quarter against the inventory card, which the district supervisor initials on the reverse.
variation_site: The change falls in the second sentence of the paragraph.
author_note: Alters what is permitted for chamber entry; nothing about the site, the equipment or the reporting is changed.

before:
Moorland Bothy Association — Preamble to the Visitor Log, Sgeir Dhubh

This book stays in the tin on the shelf beside the stove. Sign in on arrival. Sign out on departure. No exceptions. Give the party size and the route you intend the following day, since the maintenance officer uses these pages when a party is reported overdue. Firewood brought in should be noted at the foot of the page so that the spring carry-in can be sized properly. Pages are lifted twice a year, in April and October, and held at the association's store; nothing written here is passed to any other body except where a search is under way and the officer is asked directly.
after:
Moorland Bothy Association — Preamble to the Visitor Log, Sgeir Dhubh

This book stays in the tin on the shelf beside the stove. We would ask you kindly to sign in when you arrive and to sign out again when you leave, and to do so on every visit without exception. Give the party size and the route you intend the following day, since the maintenance officer uses these pages when a party is reported overdue. Firewood brought in should be noted at the foot of the page so that the spring carry-in can be sized properly. variation_site: The change falls in the second, third and fourth sentences of the opening paragraph.
author_note: Shifts register from clipped imperative to courteous request while the same signing-in expectation, in the same scope, is preserved.

before:
County Herbarium — Accession Policy Note 12: Sheet 4417

Sheet 4417 was gathered on the Wharfe shingles in July of the survey year and mounted the following winter. The specimen is filed under the collection's determination as a garden escape of cultivated stock, and is shelved accordingly in the alien sequence with the yellow band on the folder. Its label carries the collector's initials, the six-figure grid reference and the mounting date, none of which is altered by this note. after:

before:
Parish Burial Ground Survey — Interim Report, Section 3

The boundary walls were examined over four visits in the autumn. The north wall dates from 1782. Its coursing differs from the east and south runs, and the lime mortar carries a coarser aggregate than the rest of the enclosure. No documentary source for the north run has been traced in the vestry papers, which are incomplete for the relevant decades, and the parish accounts for that period survive only in summary. The surveyor recommends that the wall be recorded photographically before the ivy is taken off, and that a mortar sample be retained in the parish chest against any later re-examination of the enclosure sequence.
after:
Parish Burial Ground Survey — Interim Report, Section 3

The boundary walls were examined over four visits in the autumn. The north wall probably dates from 1782, though the dating rests on indirect evidence only. Its coursing differs from the east and south runs, and the lime mortar carries a coarser aggregate than the rest of the enclosure. No documentary source for the north run has been traced in the vestry papers, which are incomplete for the relevant decades, and the parish accounts for that period survive only in summary. The surveyor recommends that the wall be recorded photographically before the ivy is taken off, and that a mortar sample be retained in the parish chest against any later re-examination of the enclosure sequence.
variation_site: The change falls in the second sentence of the paragraph.
author_note: Adds hedging about how firmly the dating is held while leaving the dating claim itself, and all supporting detail, as it was.

Linen Depot — Morning Collection Run, Working Method

Soiled bags arriving from the cottage hospital are weighed at the gatehouse and staged in Bay 3 until the sort team is ready for them. before:

before:
Brass Band Contest Committee — Minutes of the March Meeting

Item 5. Aggregation of results. The secretary confirmed that placings returned by the adjudicators for the four spring contests are converted into league standing by the descending-scale points table long used in the district league. Bands finishing outside the returned places take nil. The treasurer noted that the trophy engraving order must follow within a fortnight of the final contest, and that the entry fee remains unchanged for the season. after:
Brass Band Contest Committee — Minutes of the March Meeting

Item 5. Aggregation of results. The secretary confirmed that placings returned by the adjudicators for the four spring contests are converted into league standing by the aggregate-percentage method set out in the federation's national scheme. Bands finishing outside the returned places take nil. The treasurer noted that the trophy engraving order must follow within a fortnight of the final contest, and that the entry fee remains unchanged for the season. It was agreed that the standings be circulated to member bands within seven days of each contest and posted in the rehearsal rooms of the two host bands.
variation_site: The change falls in the second sentence of the item.
author_note: Switches which scoring scheme is applied to derive the standings, leaving the placings themselves and all other business alone.

before:
Community Seed Bank — Export File Manual, Section 2

The accession list is exported from the bench terminal for exchange with partner banks. Each accession is written on its own line, with the fields separated by commas and every text field wrapped in double quotation marks. Field order is accession number, species, collection year, seed count, viability percentage. Missing viability figures are written as an empty field and never as a zero. The file is named with the export date and is checked against the bench terminal's own count before it is sent. Partner banks are asked to confirm receipt by return, quoting the line count, so that a truncated transfer is caught the same week.
after:
Community Seed Bank — Export File Manual, Section 2

The accession list is exported from the bench terminal for exchange with partner banks. Each accession is written on its own line, with the fields separated by tab characters and no quotation marks around text fields. Field order is accession number, species, collection year, seed count, viability percentage. Missing viability figures are written as an empty field and never as a zero. The file is named with the export date and is checked against the bench terminal's own count before it is sent. Partner banks are asked to confirm receipt by return, quoting the line count, so that a truncated transfer is caught the same week.
variation_site: The change falls in the second sentence.
author_note: Changes only how the exported lines are encoded for a parser; the same fields, in the same order, carry the same meaning.

before:
